source.name: maps
source.description: This database supports an educational assessment system that evaluates student submissions against ideal solutions for various map-based state exercises. Its central entities are maps states, which define the specific exercises and their ideal symbol configurations, and students, whose submitted solutions are recorded and compared against these standards. The system relates these entities through detailed tables that track symbol-level intersections, alignment corrections, and calculated performance ratios to determine grading outcomes.

datasets.name: maps_state_student_solution_details
datasets.description: This table stores detailed spatial solution data for students within the MAPS system, including coordinate points and symbol identification.

datasets.name: institute_codes
datasets.description: The table holds records of military institutes with their identification codes, names, and associated login credentials.

datasets.name: maps_states
datasets.description: The maps_states table stores configuration and metadata for military training map states, including names, hierarchical codes, image paths, and computer vision processing parameters.

datasets.name: army_codes
datasets.description: The table holds a list of army codes and their corresponding army names.

datasets.name: state_symbols
datasets.description: The table holds records of state symbols identified by unique IDs and associated with various classification codes.

datasets.name: maps_states_ideal_solution
datasets.description: The table holds ideal solution data for map states, including identifiers, flags, and multiple sets of coordinate values.

datasets.name: state_level_codes

datasets.name: state_type_codes

datasets.name: symbol_codes

datasets.name: maps_state_student_solution_det_aligned
datasets.description: This table stores aligned solution data for students within a specific state, including identifiers for the state, student, and symbol, along with coordinate points defining a shape.

datasets.name: maps_states_ideal_solution_old
datasets.description: The table holds mapping data for states associated with symbols and categories, including coordinate points and a flag for a specific condition.

datasets.name: api_one
datasets.description: The api_one table stores records of student performance and spatial analysis results within specific military training states, including scores, image references, and coordinate data for various map symbols.

datasets.name: api_onee
datasets.description: This table stores evaluation data for student-submitted military map symbols, including their results, geometric properties, and comparisons against ideal solutions within a specific state context.

datasets.name: asdf
datasets.description: The table holds records linking students to specific military infantry defense units along with their associated results.

datasets.name: create_rag

datasets.name: create_rag_new
datasets.description: This table stores records of student-submitted map solutions, including image paths, classified symbols with their colors, and the bounding box coordinates defining the location of each symbol within the image.
